generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.title: Block Entity
generatedFromSchema_doNotEdit.description: Requires Upcoming-Creator-Features enabled. Adds per-instance metadata for this block.

fields.title: Dynamic Properties
fields.description: Requires Upcoming-Creator-Features enabled. Sets dynamic-properties capabilities on the block-entity. Dynamic-properties can store and retrieve variables on a block via scripting, more at https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/minecraft/creator/scriptapi/minecraft/server/blockdynamicpropertiescomponent.
